name: Shelfmark
summary: A library sign-in: a wooden card catalogue opens a drawer for each letter you type and stamps your card
about: A full sign-in page for a public reading room in Lahore, with the form drawn as a lined reader's card beside a brass-handled card catalogue. Every letter you type slides out its own drawer, brass lock bars drop over the drawers and the lamp dips for your password, and a wrong password rattles the cabinet and stamps OVERDUE on the card. Signing in sends an index card flying, opens the drawers in a wave and stamps today's date in the DATE DUE box.
how: Watch the page type a demo login by itself, then click any field to take over
Type an email and watch the catalogue open the drawer for each letter
Click the password: the lock bars drop and the lamp dips; the eye button lifts them halfway
Try a wrong password for the OVERDUE stamp, or use Fill it in (ayesha@shelfmark.pk, readmore24) to check in
On Get a card each password rule puts a book on your first shelf; Lost card uses the demo code 418207
